question: At matched 10m node work, does clipping accumulated regrets improve the unchanged exact-river representation on the known medium/dry spot without degrading the known low/wet spot?
crossing: first complete iteration at or above each label; charge exact uniform initialization and retain overshoot
trainer: IID B4 external sampling, batch size 4, target order 0 then 1; independently initialize each game/arm/seed with its fixed seed and no saved-policy warm start
primary_metric: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 exploitability divided by initial pot; lower is better
paired_metric: clipped minus signed at each matched work crossing; report all three seed differences and median for each known spot
diagnostics: both-seat additive saved-prefix best-response-loss contributions for preselected medium/dry turn exact rows 2443, 1596, 14 and all turn/river rows; report opponent and continuation assumptions; diagnostic only

decision.positive: at final 10m linear average clipped passes all absolute gates; medium/dry paired median <= -0.001 initial pots; low/wet paired median <= +0.001 initial pots
decision.negative: clipped fails any absolute gate, or medium/dry paired median >= +0.001, or low/wet paired median > +0.001
decision.inconclusive: other complete outcome; failed source, compute or numerical gate stops with retained evidence

profile.forecast: for each of 12 game/seed/arm paths take maximum of three construction-through-replay whole times scaled by 10m/actual work; sum in fixed index-modulo-three worker partitions; T=max sum; require strict 2*(2*T+600)<7200

publication: prospective protocol before outcomes; isolated tested source with exact-source local/optional/hosted qualification; publish and byte-verify synthetic proof, profile and separate compute admission before own run; publish own raw before comparison-only reference; final exact-source checks
reference: pinned OpenSpiel 2.0.2 Apache-2.0 comparison-only scalar audit; no reference strategy in own training
stop_rule: one fixed 12-path matched-work run; retain complete/partial/failing results; no seed search, unfavorable retry, budget or threshold change, default promotion or claim of unseen generalization
